reasons: promql[0] selects postgresql.tup_inserted with otel_metric_type="gauge", but the definition is a monotonic sum and dataset_types lists only sum. The selector matches no series, and rate() is applied to a gauge-typed selector. Use otel_metric_type="sum".

promql[1] and promql[2] (tup_deleted, tup_updated) use the correct sum type, monotonic counters with rate over $__rate_interval, and the same avg aggregation. They are consistent with the Datadog queries.
The Datadog scope variable has no prefix and default '*', so dropping it is correct. No labels are needed, and the observed dataset labels do not affect this request.

Quantity is rows inserted/deleted/updated per second, which maps to tup_inserted/tup_deleted/tup_updated. The translated outcome is appropriate, but the first series is broken by the wrong metric type.
